name: L28-retry1
delta:
SEED ROLES. The FIRST image is the `lettering-marker-italic` environment reference — preserve its authored place facts. The SECOND image is the channel's SCENE STYLE TILE — a register sample ONLY. It pins LINE WEIGHT, the outline colour (#241a12), the FLAT-CEL RENDER, and PALETTE DISCIPLINE, and nothing else. Take NOTHING else from it — not its content, not its objects, not its layout or camera, and NOT the place it depicts. This image is not a location and never appears in the frame you draw.

A disk-drive assembly floor, cast-free, wide static eye-level from the aisle. Two long workbenches recede stage-right laid out with beige drive shells, screwdrivers and trays of small parts; steel shelving lines the left wall stacked with flat cartons; a shut roll-up shipping door closes the rear wall; fluorescent tubes run overhead and the concrete floor is sealed and pale. Framing: wide static from the aisle with the camera held strictly at standing EYE LEVEL - not elevated, no high or bird's-eye angle, no downward tilt, and never looking down the bench line from above; the bench tops read edge-on as thin horizontal lines rather than as open surfaces seen from above, and the floor occupies only the lower band of the frame, the benches stage-right and the floor entrance stage-left. Draw every edge in the register's even MEDIUM-THICK dark warm brown-black (#241a12) outline throughout, the same weight on near and far objects alike - no thin hairline strokes, no fine cool-grey or silver linework, no unoutlined shapes. Palette: beige, steel grey, cool white tube light. Above the floor entrance stage-left, a broad plank board carries 'MINISCRIBE'.
